flagged_candidate.gate_convention: Rotate each measured data Pauli to Z; CNOT data->syndrome; flag CNOT flag->syndrome after data interactions 1 and 3; measure syndrome Z and flag X; unrotate data.
flagged_candidate.design_rule: For cross checks, shell support is visited before core support. After the second flag interaction, any remaining syndrome-to-data hook is confined to T_C.

verified_cat_candidate.construction: For a weight-w check: prepare w-qubit GHZ cat by root-H and fanout; verify all Z(c0)Z(cj) parities with one reusable verifier; reject on any verifier event; couple each cat qubit transversally by CZ to exactly one rotated data qubit; measure cat in X.
verified_cat_candidate.fault_model: All 15 nonidentity two-qubit Pauli faults after each CNOT/CZ plus X/Y/Z after the cat-root H. Accepted records must have final data dressed weight <=1.

comparison.hook_containment_result: Both candidates pass their declared single-fault hook tests exactly.
comparison.preferred_development_branch: FLAGGED candidate, because it passes the hook-containment test with fewer qubits and two-qubit gates. This is not yet a full FTEC or hardware-performance result.
